submission.justification: Mixture-G3 with a 2.0 mm gas gap delivers the best time resolution of 0.888 ns across all tested configurations. This represents a significant performance improvement of 32.6% over Mixture-G2 and 55.4% over Mixture-G1. The systematic simulation across gas gaps from 1.0 to 3.0 mm confirms that G3 consistently outperforms the other candidates, with its optimal performance at 2.0 mm gap. This configuration achieves the project goal of maximizing time resolution while meeting all safety, environmental, and operational constraints. The 2.0 mm gap falls well within the specified 1-3 mm range and is compatible with the available 12 kV high-voltage system. Gas recirculation at 90% recovery ensures environmental compliance with laboratory policies.
